title: Search Listings with Multi-Criteria Filters
description: Verify users can search listings using multiple filters including geo-radius, category, and eco-tags and receive correct filtered results with map integration.

steps.description: Navigate to the listings search page.
Input a geo-radius filter centered on a specific location.
Select category filters (e.g., co-working spaces, accommodations).
Select eco-tags (e.g., solar powered, zero waste).
Trigger the search action.
Verify that the results shown match all selected filters.
Verify that map updates to show only the filtered listings with correct map pins.
Verify the search requests are debounced for performance.

title: Listing Detail Page Rendering
description: Ensure that the listing detail page correctly renders all information including images carousel, amenities, sustainability scores, centered map, related listings, and SEO metadata.

steps.description: Navigate to a listing detail page by selecting a listing.
Verify images carousel loads with accessible controls.
Verify amenities and eco-tags are displayed accurately.
Verify sustainability metrics are visible and correctly calculated.
Verify embedded map centers on the listing's coordinates.
Verify related listings slider shows relevant suggestions.
Verify SEO meta tags, canonical URLs, and structured data are present.
Check ARIA roles and keyboard navigation support for accessibility.

title: User Authentication and Role-Based Access
description: Test user login flow with role-based access control, differentiating admin, venue owner, editor, and standard user capabilities.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Attempt login with valid credentials for a standard user.
Verify user is authenticated and redirected to user homepage.
Access admin dashboard link.
Verify access is denied or redirected for standard user.
Login with valid credentials for venue owner.
Verify venue owner can access and edit their listings via Sanity CMS integration.
Login with admin credentials.
Verify admin can access moderation tools and perform bulk content operations.
Attempt unauthorized API access with standard user token.
Verify API rejects actions outside user's role permissions.

title: Admin Moderation Workflow
description: Validate admin can review flagged listings and reviews, update moderation status, and perform bulk operations correctly.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to admin listings page.
Access flagged listings and user reports.
Select multiple flagged listings for bulk approval or rejection.
Update moderation status for individual listing and review.
Verify moderation status changes reflect immediately in the UI and backend.
Verify that bulk operations perform successfully without errors.

title: Listing Management by Venue Owner via Sanity CMS
description: Test venue owner can authenticate and manage their listings including create, edit, preview drafts, and publish content with slug uniqueness validation per city.

steps.description: Login as venue owner and access Sanity CMS studio.
Create a new listing with all required fields including city, eco-tags, images, and sustainability score.
Attempt to create a listing with a duplicate slug in the same city.
Verify system prevents duplicate slug creation within the same city.
Save the listing as draft and preview the draft content.
Verify draft preview shows correctly for authenticated editors.
Publish the listing.
Verify published listings appear immediately on the platform or after webhook-triggered revalidation.

title: Review Submission and Moderation Workflow
description: Ensure authenticated users can submit listings reviews, reviews are moderated by admins, and analytics are updated accordingly.

steps.description: Login as an authenticated user.
Navigate to a listing detail page.
Submit a review with rating and comments.
Verify review is recorded in pending moderation state.
Login as admin and review pending reviews.
Approve or reject submitted review.
Verify public display updates accordingly and analytics reflect moderation changes.

title: Image Handling and Performance Optimization
description: Validate that images are served using Sanity image pipeline and Next.js image optimization features including accessibility support and CDN caching.

steps.description: Load listing detail pages with multiple images and image carousels.
Verify images utilize CDN URLs optimized by Sanity pipeline.
Verify Next.js image component lazy loads images and sets proper alt text.
Measure page load times to confirm performance benchmarks are met.

title: SEO and Accessibility Compliance
description: Check SEO metadata correctness and accessibility standards compliance including ARIA roles and keyboard support for all major pages.

steps.description: Visit homepage, listing catalog, detail pages, and editorial blog pages.
Verify presence of correct meta tags, canonical URLs, and structured data on each page.
Verify all interactive elements have appropriate ARIA roles.
Test keyboard navigation through page elements and interactive controls (maps, carousels, menus).

title: Webhook-Triggered Content Invalidation
description: Ensure that publishing or updating listings triggers webhooks to invalidate cached content and force ISR revalidation on Vercel.

steps.description: Publish or update a listing through Sanity CMS.
Verify webhook is fired and received by the platform API endpoint.
Verify webhook HMAC signature validation; unsigned or invalid signatures are rejected with 401.
Verify idempotency: repeated delivery (same event ID) does not trigger duplicate revalidation.
Simulate transient failure and verify retry with exponential backoff.
Confirm ISR revalidation occurs and stale content is replaced.
Load the updated listing page.
Verify page reflects latest listing data with no stale content.

title: Environment Variable and Configuration Validation on Setup
description: Validate environment variables are correctly loaded and validated during setup and continuous integration to prevent configuration errors.

steps.description: Run project setup scripts with correct environment variables.
Verify all required environment variables are validated and no errors are thrown.
Run setup with missing or invalid environment variables.
Verify clear error messages are displayed and setup is halted to avoid faulty configuration.

title: End-to-End User Discovery Flow
description: Test the complete user discovery journey through searching listings, viewing details, checking sustainability scores, viewing images, and saving favorites.

steps.description: Open the homepage.
Perform a search with filters and geo-location.
Verify search results appear with correct filters.
Select a listing to navigate to detail page.
Verify details including sustainability score and images are shown.
Save listing to favorites (requires authentication).
Verify listing is added to user favorites list.
